primary_goal: Retrieval query sees frozen trunk state (W_sem blend), not decode — keys stay canonical editable fp.
baseline: a=0 with same W_q is stage-256 fp query (not a reimplementation).
exam_validity: G_fp_only_at_chance on unseen_para must pass or overall SEM_QUERY_INVALID — paraphrase shares no content words with write template.
exam_258c: Train on paraphrase A + anchored on fit subjects; test unseen_para = paraphrase B of same fit relations (not held-out relation types, which were InfoNCE negatives).

verdict_read.SEM_QUERY_OK: Sem channel wins unseen_para with causal gates
verdict_read.SEM_QUERY_PARTIAL: Beats fp on seen paraphrase relations only
verdict_read.SEM_QUERY_NO_AT_SCALE: Curve and matched GPT-2 both fail unseen_para — scale/pretrain, not architecture
verdict_read.SEM_QUERY_NO: GPT succeeds, curve does not — architectural gap on this exam
verdict_read.SEM_QUERY_INVALID: Exam leaked (fp-only above chance) or tape keys drifted
